rule.name: RedundantStreamStep
rule.message: This builds an Optional, a count or a list only to ask whether anything matched or how many items there are, or copies a collection only to ask its size. Ask the stream or the collection itself: anyMatch(p) or noneMatch(p) instead of filter(p).findFirst().isPresent() or filter(p).count() > 0, count() instead of toList().size(), and no copy before size() or isEmpty().

property.name: xpath
property.value: let $filtered := function($call) { $call/*[1][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'filter'][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.Stream')]] }, $listed := function($call) { $call/*[1][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'toList' and ArgumentList/@Size = 0 or @MethodName = 'collect' and ArgumentList[@Size = 1]/MethodCall[@MethodName = ('toList', 'toUnmodifiableList')]] [*[1][pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.stream.Stream')]]] }, $copied := function($call) { $call/*[1][self::ConstructorCall[ClassType/@SimpleName = ('ArrayList', 'LinkedList', 'ArrayDeque')] [ArgumentList[@Size = 1]/*[pmd-java:typeIs('java.util.Collection')]]] } return //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('isPresent', 'isEmpty')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0] [*[1][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = ('findFirst', 'findAny')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][exists($filtered(.))]]] | //InfixExpression[@Operator = ('!=', '==')][NumericLiteral[@ValueAsInt = 0]] [MethodCall[@MethodName = 'count'][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][exists($filtered(.))]] | //InfixExpression[@Operator = '>'][*[2][self::NumericLiteral[@ValueAsInt = 0]]] [*[1][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'count'][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][exists($filtered(.))]]] | //InfixExpression[@Operator = '<'][*[1][self::NumericLiteral[@ValueAsInt = 0]]] [*[2][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'count'][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][exists($filtered(.))]]] | //InfixExpression[@Operator = '>='][*[2][self::NumericLiteral[@ValueAsInt = 1]]] [*[1][self::MethodCall[@MethodName = 'count'][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][exists($filtered(.))]]] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('size', 'isEmpty')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][exists($listed(.))] | //MethodCall[@MethodName = ('size', 'isEmpty')][ArgumentList/@Size = 0][exists($copied(.))]
